## NEXT SESSION'S MISSION (S99)

**ARCHITECTURE section 6, RUNTIME VIEW, GENERATED by a named tool in `tools/`, regenerating
byte-identically on an unchanged tree.**

WHY THIS IS TOP. It is JAMES'S roadmap 2, row 2 (DECISION S96-1), and row 1 shipped this close.
The detector is now green and discriminating, which is the precondition row 2 was waiting on:
new generated code is exactly what a working detector is for, and until this close a new
generator would have landed into a job that was already red on every push.

**Definition of done:** `tools/<name>.py` writes section 6 into `docs/GNI_ARCHITECTURE_S99.md`;
run it twice on an unchanged tree and `md5sum` both outputs - identical; then flip ONE source
fact and it moves. It refuses with exit 2 on a missing input, never a silent pass (R-S93-1), and
its published figures carry EOL-normalised hashes (R-S98-3). Section 7's generator
`tools/gni_state.py` is the pattern to follow, not to copy blindly.

**Read before designing:** section 5 (S100) is the AST job; section 6 is the RUNTIME view -
what calls what at run time, which is not the same question as what imports what. S93's close
narrowed S94 for exactly this reason. Decide the boundary in writing before the first line.

**THE ONE ITEM I WOULD RANK ABOVE THIS, for James to rule at the S99 open: item 5.30.**

## THE CROSS-ROOT DIAGNOSIS (carried from generation 7 - now with five instances)

> **GNI repeatedly measures what it has already guaranteed itself, and publishes the result as
> a fact about the world.**

| instance | what is measured | what it actually is |
|---|---|---|
| ROOT 7 | "the span exists in the pool" | reported as "the agent read it" |
| ROOT 8 gate | `_high_escalation` True six of six | a crisis channel that cannot leave crisis mode |
| ROOT 8 bonus | `diversity_bonus` at ceiling in most runs | the S39 funnel quota guarantees all three pillars |
| ROOT 8 GEO | GEO pillar "active" in every run | GEO hits far exceed the cap - the pillar cannot be inactive |
| ROOT 8 PHI | the PHI gate "protecting" the score | it has never fired; its own mute condition fires with it |

Its use is predictive - when a metric is nearly constant, ask WHO GUARANTEED IT before tuning it.
The S89, S90 and S91 notes on this table are carried in generation 16 and are not restated here;
no sixth instance was added this close, and no row changed.

**S98 NOTE - the diagnosis now has a form that points at Claude, not at GNI.** Three times this
session an instrument reported a clean result about ITSELF: a `grep -c` pattern returned zero CR
bytes for a file holding 1488, a novelty baseline reported fourteen already-read runs as new, and
a published counting command returned 36 for a file holding 47. Each was caught by a second,
differently-shaped measurement of the same object. The rule the table implies for the system also
applies to the session: when a measurement about your own method comes back clean, measure it a
second way before publishing it.

## THE ORDER

Every line carries an ISO/IEC 14764 class (DECISION S92-4): **COR**rective (something is broken),
**ADA**ptive (the world moved), **PER**fective (it works, it could be better), **PRE**ventive
(nothing is broken yet).

**EXPECTED ITEM COUNT: 46 distinct numbered items between `## THE ORDER` and `## ARCHIVED`.**
Generation 16 published 36 beside a command that returns 36 and a file that held 47: the command
counts BOLD-PREFIXED heads, and eleven items rode inside grouped lines such as
`**5.22 / 5.23 / 5.24 / 5.25**` where only the first id follows a `**` (R-S98-6). This generation
bolds EVERY id, so the published command is true of the file it is printed in, and a second
differently-shaped scan is printed beside it to reconcile against:

```bash
sed -n '/^## THE ORDER/,/^## ARCHIVED/p' docs/GNI_TARGET_AND_ORDER_S98.md \
  | grep -oE '\*\*[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | sort -u | wc -l
sed -n '/^## THE ORDER/,/^## ARCHIVED/p' docs/GNI_TARGET_AND_ORDER_S98.md \
  | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | sort -u | wc -l
```

Both must print **46**. If they disagree, an id is unbolded or a decimal has entered the prose,
and the count is not to be trusted until they agree.

## HOW THIS FILE IS MAINTAINED

Regenerated at every close, dated, superseding, never appended. The GRAVEYARD is the single
exception and is copied BY BYTES, never retyped - this generation's copy was verified against
generation 16's published md5 BEFORE the file was written (R-S95-1). The item count carries two
commands beside it, not one. Freshness confers no priority: an item found today does not outrank
an item found in June unless a measurement says so.
